name: Microsoft 365 audit logs as compromise exposure: if an Opal account is taken over, know what was seen, what left and for how long; the evidence that Opal has internal security
description: Registered at L3 by 1.0.0_SA_CTO~DELL1 on Andrew-direct 2026-10-16 ~15:59Z (the reframe), ~16:12Z (metadata only, raw audit pull) and ~16:2xZ ('all recs approved': endpoint, every account raw, SOC2 naming). Supersedes TCKT_MTADTA and inherits its live resources: the collector, the door (globgrph-trino-access-lambda, two aliases), the group globgrph-trino-access-group, the one-permission Entra app, the KMS key and opal-data-trino/m365-metadata/trino/. Collects every Opal tenant account's audit records as Microsoft ships them (no content: no mail body, message text or document content); silver is the same events in parquet; gold is per-person baselines and outside-baseline reads pulled through the door. Only the IAM globgrph group reads it, through the door. No alerting. The AWS Organization is a separate, later project. D12 placement is SITEZ; this member runs on DELL1 by his word.
